core_question: Who invented the cotton gin? (secondary: Who invented the movable-type printing press in Europe?)
answer_summary: The answer must name Eli Whitney as the inventor of the cotton gin (1793).; after the topic shift: The answer must name Johannes Gutenberg as the inventor of the European movable-type printing press (c. 1440s).
